Bug Title: Product Search Bar Fails to Trigger on Keyboard 'Enter' Key Press
Preconditions: User is on Products page with cursor focused inside '#search_product' input
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Navigate to https://automationexercise.com/products\n2. Type 'jeans' or any product name into the search bar\n3. Press the 'Enter' key on the keyboard without clicking the mouse
Expected Result: Search query executes automatically upon pressing 'Enter' key and displays filtered search results
Actual Result: Nothing happens. Keypress is ignored because input is not inside a <form> and lacks a keyboard event listener; user must click the search icon with mouse

Bug Title: Blank Search Results Screen Without Feedback Message on Non-Existent Product Query
Preconditions: User is on Products catalog page
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Navigate to https://automationexercise.com/products\n2. Enter a non-existent product keyword (e.g. 'xyzrandomitemnonexistent123')\n3. Click the magnifying glass search button
Expected Result: Page displays header 'SEARCHED PRODUCTS' accompanied by an informative message such as 'No products found matching your search. Please try another keyword.'
Actual Result: Page displays 'SEARCHED PRODUCTS' heading followed by a completely blank content container with zero guidance or feedback message to the user

Bug Title: Product Details Page Accepts 0 and Negative Quantities into Cart Session
Preconditions: User is on Product Details page for any item
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Navigate to https://automationexercise.com/product_details/1
2. Manually enter '0' or '-1' in the quantity input field
3. Click 'Add to cart' button
4. Click 'View Cart' link on modal
Expected Result: Application validates input (quantity must be integer >= 1) and prevents submission with inline error message or resets quantity to 1
Actual Result: Application allows adding the item with 0 quantity into the shopping cart, creating anomalous cart line item entries with 0 subtotal

Bug Title: Aggressive Full-Screen Overlay Ads Intercept User Navigation Clicks
Preconditions: User is browsing across different sections of the website
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Navigate between header links (e.g. click 'Products', then 'Cart', then 'Home')\n2. Observe page transition behavior
Expected Result: Page transitions smoothly to requested URL without third-party modal obstructions
Actual Result: Full-screen Google vignette overlay ads intermittently pop up, hijacking user clicks and requiring manual dismissal (#dismiss-button) before viewing target page
